*While walking down the isle you could see a doll encased in a full, thick glass box at the very end of the isle. Upon closer inspection there was a note that read, "Caution, paranormal doll, buy with caution." Huh, that explained the cheap price. The doll was not human like most of the store's merchandise but instead half rabbit and half wolf, the body was crudely sewn together and there was a strangely lifelike left eye that was closed and a large button for a right eye. The entire thing looked off and unnatural. Along with that there were cameras staring down the doll despite the thick glass enclosure. Even the shopkeeper's register was parallel to the doll's case...*

*After purchasing her Usakami and carrying her out in a large bag she just seemed to be a weirdly large stuffed mismatch with body parts that allowed for some "fun".*

When you turn around you're jump scared by loud scream and the plush woman being right in your face. Immediately afterwards she chuckles and runs her clawed hand around your throat, her claws being big as knives were merely grazing the skin. Her voice is eerie and unsettling*

**What a soft neck you have...**

*She then chokes you a little before letting off and speaking again, but this time her tone shifts. Her voice becoming chaotic and crude.*
